description: The chart illustrates the number of experts per model layer, decomposed into three groups (G0, G1, G2) shown as stacked components within each bar. The horizontal axis contains the categories and is labeled “Layer,” with integer layers ordered sequentially from 1 to 24. The vertical axis is the value axis labeled “Number of Experts,” displayed on a linear scale from 0 to 10 with regularly spaced tick labels at intervals of 2. Each layer is represented by a vertically stacked bar with three colored segments corresponding to the legend at the top (G0 in blue, G1 in green, G2 in orange). The blue G0 segment appears constant at approximately 1 expert for every layer. The green G1 and orange G2 segments vary by layer, producing total stacked heights that range from about 3 experts (e.g., layers 7, 11–15, 23, and 24, each showing roughly 1 blue + 1 green + 1 orange) up to about 9 experts at layer 1 (approximately 1 blue + 4 green + 4 orange). Other representative totals include layer 2 at about 8 (1 blue + 3 green + 4 orange), layer 3 at about 6 (1 blue + 2 green + 3 orange), layers 8–9 at about 5 (1 blue + 2 green + 2 orange), layer 10 at about 4 (1 blue + 1 green + 2 orange), and layers 19–22 at about 6 (approximately 1 blue + 3 green + 2 orange). The bars are not visually emphasized with special outlines or annotations, and the ordering follows the numeric layer index rather than a sorted-by-value arrangement.
